import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int MOD;
    static long[][] dp;
    static int[] rf, f;

    static long mpow(long x, int n) {
        long res = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) res = (res * x) % MOD;
            x = (x * x) % MOD;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int permute(int n, int m) {
        return (int) ((long) f[n] * rf[n - m] % MOD);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextInt();

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(mpow(K, n));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        f = new int[n + 1];
        rf = new int[n + 1];

        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = (int) ((long) f[i - 1] * i % MOD);
        }

        rf[n] = (int) mpow(f[n], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            rf[i] = (int) ((long) rf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD);
        }

        int maxK = K + 1;
        dp = new long[maxK + 1][n + 1];

        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if ((i & n) != i) continue;
                int cnt = 0;
                long res = 0;
                int hb = 1 << (31 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(i));
                for (int j = i - hb; j >= 0; j = (j - 1) & i) {
                    int jj = j + hb;
                    res += dp[k][i ^ jj] * rf[jj];
                    if (++cnt == 17) {
                        res %= MOD;
                        cnt = 0;
                    }
                    if (j == 0) break;
                }
                dp[k + 1][i] = res % MOD;
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            long temp = ((long) f[n] * dp[i][n]) % MOD;
            temp = (temp * permute(K, i)) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + temp) % MOD;
        }

        long result = (mpow(K, n) + MOD - ans) % MOD;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
